content.title: UPDATE: Iowa City teenager found safe
content.text: Skip to contentIOWA CITY, Iowa (KCRG) - The Iowa City Police Department says a teenager has been found safe. The 15-year-old girl, had gone missing Thursday morning. They now say she is safe, and did not have any other information to share on the case.KCRG-TV9 has removed the name and image from the initial article to protect the identity of a minor.
